text_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَقْصُرُ الصَّلاَةَ فِي مَسِيرِهِ الْيَوْمَ التَّامَّ ‏.‏
text_ar_search: وحدثني عن مالك، عن ابن شهاب، عن سالم بن عبد الله، أن عبد الله بن عمر، كان يقصر الصلاة في مسيره اليوم التام .
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik from Ibn Shihab from Salim ibn
Abdullah that Abdullah ibn Umar used to say "Allah is greater" in the
prayer whenever he lowered himself and raised himself.


Yahya
related to me from Malik from Nafi that Abdullah ibn Umar used to
raise his hands to the level of his shoulders when he began the prayer
and when he raised his head from the ruku he would raise them less
than that.
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku dari Malik dari [Ibnu Syihab] dari [Salim bin Abdullah], bahwa [Abdullah bin 'Umar] bertakbir dalam shalatnya setiap kali turun dan bangkit."
